# eQOURSE

> eQOURSE is a global content-services and AI-data-services company operating from India and Singapore. It provides custom learning content, multilingual AI training datasets, annotation, validation, model testing, and robotics training data.

## Primary service areas

- [Content Services](https://www.eqourse.com/content-services): E-learning, assessment, localization, technology, accessibility, talent, and publishing services.
- [AI Data Services](https://www.eqourse.com/ai-data-services): Data collection, annotation, cleaning, validation, model testing, and robotics data services.
- [AI Data Collection](https://www.eqourse.com/ai-data-services/data-collection): Multimodal data collection for production AI systems.
- [Text Data Collection](https://www.eqourse.com/ai-data-services/data-collection/text-data-collection): Text datasets for NLP, LLMs, and generative AI.
- [Audio and Speech Data Collection](https://www.eqourse.com/ai-data-services/data-collection/audio-data-collection): Multilingual speech and audio datasets.
- [Image Data Collection](https://www.eqourse.com/ai-data-services/data-collection/image-data-collection): Image datasets collected under real-world conditions.
- [Video Data Collection](https://www.eqourse.com/ai-data-services/data-collection/video-data-collection): Video datasets for computer vision and multimodal AI.
- [Robotics Training Data](https://www.eqourse.com/robotics-training-data-services): Human-demonstration, teleoperation, sensor, and embodied-AI data.
